name: Duel
description: Taunts the target enemy into a duel. For %duration% turns, neither unit will be able to act. At the end of their turns, each unit is forced to attack their opponent. When a unit dies in a duel, the winner will recieve %duel_bonus% bonus to all stats, and heal for %duel_heal% % of their max health. Defeating a non-basic unit will recieve %win_multiplier% times the stat bonuses. If dueled units are seperated through external means, the duel will end early.
